hypotheses.R0_current_token_routes_operator_state: Exact current-token lookup explains at least 0.20 of top-64 operator-coordinate energy at every layer.
hypotheses.R1_embedding_geometry_generalizes_router: A 128D current-embedding ridge router is within 0.05 weighted R2 of exact-token lookup at every layer.
hypotheses.R2_short_context_improves_routing: Adding previous-token and previous-eight-token embedding summaries improves weighted R2 by at least 0.05 over current embedding at Layers 4 and 5.
hypotheses.R3_contextual_routing_strengthens_with_d: The mean short-context gain at Layers 4-5 exceeds the mean gain at Layers 0-1 by at least 0.03.
hypotheses.R4_state64_is_a_compact_router: A 64D natural-state router explains at least 0.70 of top-64 operator-coordinate energy at every layer.
hypotheses.R5_short_context_recovers_half_oracle_op: The short-context router recovers at least half of the top-64 oracle's total held-out operator R2 at every layer.
hypotheses.R6_position_is_not_the_primary_router: Position lookup remains at least 0.05 weighted R2 below short-context routing at every layer.
